title: Heavy Duty yes,  but don't try to overload it
text:
Heavy Duty yes, but don't try to overload it. These are very nice grocery bags. They open wide and the material seems durable. The bottom, however, is not meant for heavy packing. I take these and put all the bread and bagels in it. Or, cereal boxes. The base is not strong enough to support heavy cans. Nor should it support the gallon of milk.

The sides feel like lite cardboard, and that cardboard feel means it will not support much. So, use it sparingly if you use it for groceries!
